profile.headline: Senior Systems Software Engineer/Architect - ServiceNow at Northwestern Mutual
profile.summary:
•	Experienced Information Technology (IT) Professional with over 30 years of IT experience
•	Background in the IT Service Management (ITSM) space with over 30 years of experience working with HP Service Manager and ServiceNow.
•	Outstanding reputation for producing high-quality products with minimal to no defects.
•	Excellent Problem-Solving Skillset, which helps tremendously in troubleshooting technical issues.
•	Detailed Oriented with outstanding documenting skills.
•	Analytical Thinker which helps in designing the best well-rounded solutions for my platform
•	Skilled in ITSM, HP Service Manager, ServiceNow, Microsoft Products, System Administration, System Upgrades, Planning, Design, Requirements Analysis, Relational Databases, Java Script, XML, HTML, and Various Operating Systems.
•	Team Player

positions.title: Senior ServiceNow Developer/Administrator (Consultant)
positions.description:
•	Skilled in the processes around these various IT Service Management (ITSM) Modules: Change Management, Problem Management, Incident Management, Request Management, Service Level Agreements (SLA), Knowledge Management & On-Call.
•	Utilized the following components of the ServiceNow application:  System Properties, Workflows, Java Script, Client Script, Script Includes, UI Actions, UI Policy, UI Policy Actions, Tables, Business Rules, UI Forms, Form Layout, Form Designer, Dictionary Entry, Dashboards, Reports, Interactive Filters, Plugins, Notifications, Notification Email Scripts, Inceptors, ACL’s, Record Producers, Catalog Items, Service Portal, Service Portal Widgets, UI Pages, Portal Pages, Portal Instance Menu , SLA Definitions, Knowledge Articles, Fix Scripts, Group Administration, Role Administration, Update Sets, Scheduled Jobs, ServiceNow ODBC Driver, Performance Analytics. 
•	Worked with external vendors on integrating Kemper ServiceNow system with Ensono ServiceNow system for handling mainframe issues and requests. Assisted with system testing, troubleshooting of issues/code and documentation for this integration.  This integration was mainly built using Rest Messages, Rest Methods, Script Includes and Business Rules.
•	Redesigned the Kemper Service Portal which included creating and modifying Service Portal Widgets, Portal Pages, and Portal Instance Menus.
•	Created new Service Portal Approval Widget to allow approving of records from the Service Portal for ITIL Users.
•	Modified Major Incident Workbench UI Page to include additional required fields when resolving Major Incidents from the Major Incident Workbench.
•	Customized Outage Table to Calculate Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) of Incidents based on Incident Creation Date and Outage Start Date
•	Built Maintenance Fix Scripts to assist with maintenance related items.
•	Assist with testing and upgrade to the Orlando and Paris Release of ServiceNow.

positions.title: Senior Service Delivery Engineer (ServiceNow Developer/Administrator)
positions.description:
•	Skilled in the processes around these various IT Service Management (ITSM) Modules: Change Management, Problem Management, Incident Management, Request Management and Knowledge Management
•	Utilized the following components of the ServiceNow application:  System Properties, Workflows, Client Script, Catalog Client Script, Script Includes, Catalog Script Includes, UI Actions, Catalog UI Actions, UI Policy, UI Policy Actions, Catalog UI Policy, Catalog UI Policy Actions, Tables, Business Rules, UI Forms, Form Layout, Form Designer, Dictionary Entry, Dashboards, Reports, Plugins, Notifications, Notification Email Scripts, Inceptors, ACL’s, Record Producers, Catalog Items, Choice List, Variable Sets, User Record Administration, Group Administration, Role Administration, Update Sets, Scheduled Jobs, Widgets, ServiceNow ODBC Driver
•	Heavily worked on the Service Catalog Module as the Lead for that Module
•	Heavily worked on the Change Management Module as the Lead for that Module.  Rolled out Standard Changed and Developed Detail Standard Change User Training Documentation. 
•	Worked some with Service Portal, utilizing the available widgets.  Removed deprecated widgets and replace with most recent out of box widgets.  Made minor changes to custom widgets that allowed for things like more data to show on the Approval Widget of the Service Portal.
•	Installed and Configured ServiceNow ODBC Driver
•	Installed the ServiceNow Mid Server in Development Environment

positions.title: ServiceNow Developer/Administrator (Consultant)
positions.description:
•	Skilled in the process around these various IT Service Management (ITSM) Modules: (Change Management, Problem Management, Incident Management, Request Management & Knowledge Management)
•	Redesigned the Change Management Module to be closer to out of box functionality.  
•	Implemented a new flow that drives necessary approvals for Change Management based on the configuration item and/or business service selected as well as the requested by user manager.
•	Designed and developed workflows for the Change Management Module.
•	Design and modified various Notifications and Notification Email Scripts.
•	Created Reports and Dashboards against various Service Now tables that were utilized for various metrics needed by management.
•	Created Excel csv file by executing various scripting in the Xplore application.
•	Worked with various components of the Service Catalog (record producers, maintain items)
•	Utilized various components of ServiceNow like Client Script, Script Include, UI Action, UI Policy Action, Tables, Business Rules, UI Pages, UI Forms, Form Layout, Workflows, Dictionary Entry, UI Policy
•	Skilled with using update set and migrating code between the various environments using update sets.
•	Assist with testing our ServiceNow environments after patches or major releases are applied to our environments.
•	Exporting and importing data in XML files.
•	Assist in troubleshooting bugs and applying necessary fixes to the ServiceNow application.
•	Implemented an approach for redesigning the complete Service Catalog to be more streamlined.
•	Worked with Glide Scripting / Java Scripting
•	Supplied content for developing How-to-Videos for various components of Change Management and Incident Management Modules

positions.title: Principal System Engineer
positions.description:
•	Technical Lead for the HP Service Manager Application
•	Help lead efforts for upgrading Service Manager from version 7.11 to 9.32 as well as from version 9.32 to 9.40
•	As the HP Service Manager Tech Lead, I worked with the Connect-It SME and an external vendor on integrating our United Airlines ServiceNow Change Management and Incident Modules with an external Vendor Ticketing System.  The Vendor was responsible for initiating patching in the United environment using a Change Management Ticket that was sync between the two systems.  Any errors resulted in an Incident Ticket being opened in the United system from the external vendor
•	Worked with a United Airlines Web Developer SME on integrating HP Service Manager to a United Airlines external Home-Grown Web-Based Service Catalog Portal.  I setup Service Manager to receive requests, changes, and incidents from this external portal.  I built the necessary WSDLs needed for the integration, as well as setup the additional coding needed internally to Service Manager for this integration
•	Provided estimates to our IT Process Owners as well as leadership as it relates to work being done in my supported application.
•	Awarded the SPM Shining Star Award from Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) for “Most Successful Upgrades of HP Service Manager” in April 2015
•	Serve as the SME of the HP Service Manager tool and drove solutions necessary to implement tasks based on customer requirements.
•	Participate in weekly bi-weekly collaboration meetings between the Engineer Team, Process Team, other IT areas, various Business Units as well as third-party vendors to form a cohesive unit to achieve common company goals.
•	Serve as the gatekeeper for all code being moved into the Service Manager Production environment
•	Work with Windows Engineer Team monthly as it pertains to having up to date OS Microsoft patches applied to our designated servers.
•	Assist with Data Migration from HP Service Manager to the ServiceNow Application.

positions.title: System Programmer III
positions.description:
•	Technical Lead for the HP Service Manager application
•	Served as the Subject Matter Expert of the HP Service Manager tool and drove solutions necessary to implement tasks based on my customer requirements and expectations.
•	Lead the efforts to upgrade HP ServiceCenter from version 6.1 to Service Manager 7.11
•	Developed live audio and visual user training videos for my customers to make the transition of moving from ServiceCenter 6.1 to Service Manager 7.11 smoother
•	Served as the go-to person for any issues, concerns, or questions as it related to the Service Manager application
•	Performed necessary troubleshooting needed, coupled with vendor collaboration, to resolve system issues as quickly as possible.
•	Installed and Implemented the Knowledge Management Module, Help Server, and the Web Client (Tomcat/Apache) on the Service Manager 7.11 Application

positions.title: System Programmer II
positions.description:
•	Technical Lead for the HP ServiceCenter application
•	Served as the Subject Matter Expert of the HP ServiceCenter application
•	Lead the efforts to upgrade ServiceCenter from version 5.1 to version 6.1.
•	Utilized analytical as well as technical skills to decipher upgrade exception reports.
•	Integrated ServiceCenter 6.1 with Active Directory
•	Served on the IT Diversity Business Council to help support the efforts to integrate diversity and inclusion in the IT organization.  Our council received the “Excellence in Diversity” Award the last 2 years of my tenure for our diligent and hard work toward this initiative.
•	Attended bi-weekly one on one meetings with my Director to assure everything was running smoothly within my space.

positions.title: Developer II
positions.description:
•	Co-Lead the efforts to upgrade ServiceCenter from version 3.0 to version 5.1.
•	Processed line by line application upgrade reports to determine what code required additional modifications and review.
•	Functioned as one of the Subject Matter Expert (SME) of the ServiceCenter tool set.
•	Attended various collaboration sessions with my customers to gather system requirements needed.
•	Utilized strong analytical skills to troubleshoot known issues with the toolset.

positions.title: Senior System Network Analyst
positions.description:
•	Functioned as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) of the ServiceCenter toolset
•	Assured the stability of the system was always acceptable and if not worked with the vendor to resolve the issue.
•	Attended various collaboration sessions with my Process Owners to gather system requirement needs.
•	Collaborated with the Service Manager Steering Committee on identifying the priority of work to be done within the ServiceCenter toolset.
•	Help assure the health of the system was always intact through good communication with my UNIX Administrators as well as my Database Administrators.
•	Managed my team while by boss was out on Maternity Leave.
•	Worked well with other SMEs from other areas to accomplish common goals.

positions.title: System Network Analyst II
positions.description:
•	Responsible for assuring the ServiceCenter application was Y2K compliant by implementing various use cases in a controlled lab environment and making necessary changes needed.
•	Trained the beginner developers on the intricacies of the ServiceCenter application toolset.
•	Lead the efforts for upgrading ServiceCenter from 2.1 to 3.0.  The application resided on a UNIX based operating system with the backend moving from Oracle to UDB.
•	Performed system maintenance to include ServiceCenter file system scans, file system compressions, system shutdowns, and system backups.
•	Worked cohesively with the primary Process Owner on coming up with solutions to meet the customer’s needs.

honors.title: SPM Shining Star Award (Most Successful Upgrade of HP Service Manager)
honors.description: Awarded this award for my involvement in helping making our upgrade from HP Service Manager 7.11 to Service Manager 9.3 a success.
honors.issuer: Issued by Hewlett Packard Enterprise · Apr 2015

honors.title: Academic Excellence Award in Computer and Information System
honors.issuer: Issued by University of North Florida · Dec 1995
